what: Model operations at the sizes of 10 §5 (100 000 strokes in one drawing, 10 000 swatches, 1 000 elements, 10 000 drawings in a bank), release build, single run.
timeOrigin: each value is std::time::Instant elapsed around one operation (wall clock, ms); no absolute timestamps
caveats: single run, no warm-up repetitions, background load not controlled
diffWholeDocumentNoSharedEntriesMs compares every object because the second document was assembled from cloned parts; the executor shares unchanged entries (C1.2)
diffOneStrokeIn100kStrokeEntryMs is a whole-entry diff; C1.2 limits diffs to the objects a transaction touched
